pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft-edged pixel gradients. Large-area patches on the flank transition to smaller, more fragmented geometries toward the lower neck and ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored inter-patch spaces. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively wide and consistent across the flank, maintaining topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the cervical ridge. Individual hair-level serration is visible but softened by background motion blur and resolution limits.
